ambient.defender_note: Microsoft Defender real-time protection left on (AntivirusEnabled True, RealTimeProtectionEnabled True, AMRunningMode Normal), no exclusions added. Its scanning of freshly downloaded files can slow the downloads and the first read of each file; llama-bench loads the model and runs a warmup before it times anything, so this does not enter the measurements.
ambient.gpu_tools_and_overlays: MSI Afterburner not running. RTSS closed by the operator before measuring. NVIDIA Overlay (NVIDIA App) processes were stopped once but are respawned by nvcontainer within seconds; they were running (no game, overlay not shown) during the measurements. Steam and Rockstar Social Club Vulkan layers are registered but neither application was running.
ambient.hyte_nexus: HYTE Nexus (case control software, service and app) ran throughout; HYTE.Nexus.Service had accumulated 1866 s of CPU time since boot at 10:04Z (about 0.1 core on average). It also appears as a C+G process on the GPU.

background_logger.how: PowerShell loop calling the brief's nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,pstate,clocks.gr,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,power.draw,enforced.power.limit,temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu,memory.used,fan.speed,clocks_event_reasons.active --format=csv,noheader once per second, appending each line; stopped through a stop file at the end of the section. Used instead of nvidia-smi -lms 1000 -f, which buffered its output and wrote 0 bytes when stopped with Stop-Process in a test on this machine. clocks_event_reasons.active was accepted by this driver.
